definitions.explanation: The act of opening a sealed letter, package, or container. Used as a suru verb.

examples.japanese: {荷物|にもつ}を{開封|かいふう}する。
{開封|かいふう}{後|ご}はお{早|はや}めにお{召|め}し{上|あ}がりください。
{開封|かいふう}{済|ず}みの{商品|しょうひん}は{返品|へんぴん}できませんのでご{了承|りょうしょう}ください。
examples.english: Please note that opened products cannot be returned.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on product labels and in online shopping contexts. {開封|かいふう}{済|ず}み means "already opened" and {未開封|みかいふう} means "unopened."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {開封|かいふう}する (to open/unseal)
- {開封|かいふう}{後|ご} (after opening)
- {開封|かいふう}{済|ず}み (already opened)
- {未開封|みかいふう} (unopened)

CONTRAST:
- {封|ふう}をする: to seal — the opposite action
